verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for an online public-service portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence lists only conventional services: account login, contact and appointment booking, a phone line, simulators, forms, tutorials and online payment. None of it mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
